name: @shanelevs/pi-memory-auto
description: 🧠 Memory extension for the pi coding agent — memories stored as body + 1-3 keywords, a unique keyword table injected into every session, keyword lookup the agent drives itself, duplicate-merging consolidation every N memories. Zero heavy deps.
